text: I'm so sorry to bother you at this hour. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 11. Her temperature is 37.6. She can't bend her head forward, I asked her to look down at her tummy and she just won't, says her neck won't go. She's also had runny poos today but she's drinking lots and weeing normally so I don't think she's dried out. There's been no fit or shaking or anything like that. I didn't know whether to wake her parents or ring you first. Thank you and sorry again.
